mission.zh: 建立有一手证据、可按专长检索的原创双语创作者技术档案，不镜像或重新授权第三方作品。
mission.en: An evidence-led bilingual index of creators, specialties and learnable techniques; linked works retain their owners' rights.

creators.name: Theo Tillberg

specialty.zh: 基于真实苔藓和地衣形态的互动表面覆盖、绘画笔刷、生长与复杂材质演出。
specialty.en: Interactive moss/lichen growth, paintable surfaces and expressive multi-layer vegetation materials.

reusable_methods.zh: 学习 16 层 shell undercoat、实例化细枝、五物种权重混合、表面法线与光照；按需改造可生长苔藓系统。
reusable_methods.en: Study shell-textured undercoat, instanced fronds, five-species weight blending, surface normals and responsive lighting.

creators.rights_note: Repository MIT (credit Theo Tillberg); fonts, demo visuals and dependencies need independent notice checks.

creators.name: Ricardo Cabello (mr.doob)

specialty.zh: Three.js 创建者；擅长把三维渲染、物理表现与交互实验组织为小而精的可运行作品。
specialty.en: Creator of Three.js, known for practical browser rendering experiments and compact interactive studies.

reusable_methods.zh: 研究渲染器 API、创意编码演示、材质与动态模拟的最小复现；逐个核对每日主题源码。
reusable_methods.en: Study renderer architecture and self-contained procedural experiments; verify each daily piece directly from source.

creators.rights_note: Three.js MIT; individual demo source and third-party resources have separate rights.

creators.name: Jaume Sánchez Elias (Spite)

specialty.zh: 长期研究 WebGL 着色器、生成式形态、感知与交互反馈；也是 Codevember 主题的重要推动者。
specialty.en: Creative WebGL and shader experiments exploring generative form, input, motion and visual perception.

reusable_methods.zh: 学习从概念词到可交互视觉实验的方法，研究动态草形与图形反馈；不能将可见源码默认视为 MIT。
reusable_methods.en: Study prompt-to-prototype exploration and procedural motion; public code is not automatically MIT licensed.

creators.rights_note: 2021 repository explicitly says 'Ask and we’ll see'; permission required before code reuse.

creators.name: Bruno Simon

specialty.zh: 可游玩的 3D 个人网站、车辆操作、物理交互、场景细节与工程教学的结合。
specialty.en: Playable 3D portfolios combining responsive vehicle controls, physics and polished scene presentation.

reusable_methods.zh: 学习从玩家输入、摄像机、物理、世界构建到细节反馈的完整游戏体验；保留原创角色与资产。
reusable_methods.en: Transfer complete interaction loops, camera/physics coupling and polished audiovisual feedback into original games.

creators.rights_note: Folio source may be MIT; check exact repository and music/model/third-party asset notices individually; course content is not open.

creators.name: Sunag

specialty.zh: Three.js 节点着色和 TSL/WebGPU 体系的重要贡献者，使复杂材质逐步具备跨渲染后端的表达能力。
specialty.en: A key contributor to Three.js node materials and its TSL/WebGPU ecosystem.

reusable_methods.zh: 研究 TSL 材质图、WebGPURenderer/回退语义、自定义 Shader 迁移和可测的材质兼容矩阵。
reusable_methods.en: Study TSL node graphs, renderer compatibility and verified WebGPU/WebGL2 material migration.

creators.rights_note: Three.js MIT; individual shaders, examples and bundled media must retain their own notices.

creators.name: Paul Henschel (drcmda)

specialty.zh: React Three Fiber 的创建者，擅长可组合的三维场景、组件化交互和前端状态管理。
specialty.en: Creator of React Three Fiber, focused on composable 3D components and interactive React scenes.

reusable_methods.zh: 学习场景组件边界、输入与状态驱动、3D 资产封装与游戏代码组织；勿把抽象层误当美术本身。
reusable_methods.en: Study reusable scene modules, state-driven interaction and asset components without confusing architecture with art quality.

creators.rights_note: R3F source MIT; third-party models and examples have independent rights.

creators.name: Garrett Johnson

specialty.zh: 高效几何查询、BVH、CSG、路径追踪和 Web 三维光照质量研究。
specialty.en: Fast mesh queries, BVH, constructive geometry and physically based path tracing for browser 3D.

reusable_methods.zh: 学习高面数场景射线交互、空间查询和离线/渐进式高品质渲染，用实测确定加速收益。
reusable_methods.en: Study ray queries, spatial acceleration and progressive render comparisons without assuming runtime FPS benefits.

creators.rights_note: Project-specific open-source licenses; sample meshes/environments are separately licensed.

creators.name: Don McCurdy

specialty.zh: glTF 资产转换、压缩、编辑与规范化工具的关键作者；适合构建可靠的游戏模型工厂。
specialty.en: Author of glTF Transform, focused on reproducible glTF editing, optimization and asset conversion.

reusable_methods.zh: 学习格式校验、纹理压缩、材质与节点清理及可复现转换，不在美术确认前强行降低视觉质量。
reusable_methods.en: Study reproducible format transformations and texture compression, with art-fidelity QA before optimization.

creators.rights_note: glTF Transform MIT; input/output models preserve their original asset rights.

creators.name: Yuri Artiukh (akella)

specialty.zh: 擅长 Shader、镜面玻璃、体积光、文字变形和交互网页效果的源码拆解与教学。
specialty.en: Creative developer known for shader breakdowns, glass effects, volumetric rays and animated typography.

reusable_methods.zh: 学习从参考网站拆出可验证的渲染通道、纹理坐标与后处理，再用于原创游戏场景。
reusable_methods.en: Extract testable shader and postprocessing mechanisms from reference work before original implementation.

creators.rights_note: Article prose, demo code, images and third-party assets may have different licenses; inspect per example.

creators.name: Maxime Heckel

works.title: The Study of Shaders with React Three Fiber

specialty.zh: 擅长把着色器、光照和三维图形原理拆解成能交互验证的教学可视化。
specialty.en: Explains shaders and real-time graphics through interactive visual explanations.

reusable_methods.zh: 借鉴分步参数分析、可运行的演示、技术与视觉原因一一对应的验证方式。
reusable_methods.en: Use progressive visual explanations, controlled parameters and inspectable shader experiments.

creators.rights_note: Educational article and demo rights require individual review; do not mirror paid or copyrighted content.

creators.name: Akihiro Oyamada (Yomotsu)

specialty.zh: 基于 Three.js 的自然物体生成和空间渲染，涵盖树木、卵石、草花、苔藓和雾。
specialty.en: Procedural natural objects and spatial rendering experiments with trees, pebbles, flowers, moss and fog.

reusable_methods.zh: 研究种子生成、真实碰撞几何、地表苔藓、Workers 和 LOD；以精细美术设计决定最终风格。
reusable_methods.en: Study seeded vegetation, grounded moss, collider separation and async generation; retain authored art direction.

creators.rights_note: Vegetation MIT; inspect any linked textures, 3D assets and demo rights separately.

creators.name: Mike Fernandez

specialty.zh: 以分枝骨架、叶簇继承法线和纹理卡片制作风格化树木，并提供浏览器参数编辑与 GLB 导出。
specialty.en: Procedural stylized trees using branch structures, leaf-clump normals and paintable canopy cards.

reusable_methods.zh: 研究可重建的树木物种结构、风动与跨引擎导出；保留视觉验证，避免树冠变成重复球团。
reusable_methods.en: Reuse botanical branching and leaf-card methods, wind and export design; verify silhouette from every angle.

creators.rights_note: MIT source; separately credited audio, model and demonstration media retain their own rights.

creators.name: Matthew Kissinger

specialty.zh: 互动风格化草地、确定性散布、多尺度风场和角色穿过时的草浪反馈。
specialty.en: Interactive stylized grass with deterministic scatter, layered wind and settling body wakes.

reusable_methods.zh: 学习密度和地形接触规则、风场与交互形变；草叶美术纹理必须单独设计。
reusable_methods.en: Transfer terrain-aware density sampling, wind and responsive grass; author final leaf/grass textures separately.

creators.rights_note: Core MIT; demonstration character and animation have CC BY 4.0 and/or Adobe terms.

creators.name: Artem Sinica (Sinica)

specialty.zh: 温暖精致的微缩自然世界，善于用植物组合、自然河岸、材质与光色营造柔和氛围。
specialty.en: Developer of a lush cozy 3D world combining natural foliage, shorelines, material harmony and gentle lighting.

reusable_methods.zh: 学习先锁定参考图与艺术方向，再叠加可信尺度的植被生态和手工场景布局，而非照搬游戏资源。
reusable_methods.en: Study reference-led art direction, scale, botanical clustering, natural shores and authored composition.

creators.rights_note: Commercial game/art assets; creator notes are study references, not a license to copy.

creators.name: Kayla Kosik

specialty.zh: 手绘植物图集、按轮廓裁切的叶片网格、场景构图、天空与环境材质统一。
specialty.en: Environment artist specializing in hand-painted foliage atlases, silhouette-cut vegetation and cozy scenes.

reusable_methods.zh: 先绘制植物种类与材质，再建网格并合成空间与光线；不以屏幕后处理代替原始美术。
reusable_methods.en: Paint distinct botanical species first, map them onto trimmed geometry and compose lighting and sky coherently.

creators.rights_note: Artwork and breakdown retain artist and third-party rights; do not copy textures or models.

creators.name: Cédric Babouche

specialty.zh: 真实水彩绘画与三维摄影机投射的融合，擅长用传统画面构成叙事氛围。
specialty.en: Art director associated with genuine painted watercolor projected into navigable 3D scenes.

reusable_methods.zh: 研究多视角 Camera Mapping、绘画光影与叙事镜头，但自由旋转视角需额外三维材质覆盖。
reusable_methods.en: Study camera-mapped artwork and artistic lighting, with clear limitations for unrestricted 3D camera orbit.

creators.rights_note: Dordogne paintings and game assets are proprietary; cited interviews are not a grant of reuse rights.

creators.name: Wildward (@PlayWildward) — creator account

works.title: Driving, interactions & simulated water / 驾驶与模拟水
Jeep and procedural grass / 车辆与程序化草
Procedural world & autumn / 程序化秋季世界

specialty.zh: 以三维越野车贯穿程序化森林、自然地形、草被交互和河流水体的多系统视觉表达；项目称支持一至四人合作。
specialty.en: A cooperative wilderness project presenting Jeep driving, terrain response, grass interaction and simulated rivers in cohesive 3D scenes.

reusable_methods.zh: 研究车轮接地、植被动态、涉水波纹、光色构图及地表生态过渡；目前只有公开视频，真实引擎和源码未核实。
reusable_methods.en: Study vehicle-ground contacts, grass deformation, river disturbance, coherent color design and ecosystem transitions; no engine source has been verified.

creators.rights_note: Source videos are promotional posts, not open-source or reusable game assets. Do not associate with wildwardgames.com medieval-fantasy studio without direct identity proof.
